title: Estimation of Propagated Risk in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems introduce a distinctive reliability challenge in which actions taken by upstream agents can affect the correctness of downstream agents. While prior work has investigated error propagation and developed methods for estimating uncertainty inherited from upstream agents, existing approaches do not explicitly model how realized sender-receiver interactions contribute to downstream error risk under different sender correctness states. In this work, we study agent-level error-risk estimation from multi-agent execution traces. We propose Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents. For each sender-receiver interaction, the model combines these conditional effects using the sender's estimated error risk, and recursively propagates the resulting risk estimates through the execution graph. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中传播风险的估计
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统带来了一种独特的可靠性挑战：上游智能体所采取的行动可能会影响下游智能体的正确性。尽管已有研究探讨了错误传播问题，并开发了估计从上游智能体继承的不确定性的方法，但现有方法并未显式建模在不同发送方正确性状态下，实际发生的发送-接收交互如何影响下游的错误风险。在本工作中，我们从多智能体执行轨迹中研究智能体级别的错误风险估计。我们提出了交互效应传播，这是一个以交互为条件的模型，能够分别学习正确与错误上游智能体的效应。对于每个发送-接收交互，该模型利用发送方的估计错误风险将这些条件效应组合起来，并在执行图中递归地传播所得的风险估计。我们……
tldr: 该论文提出交互效应传播模型，通过条件化建模发送-接收交互在不同发送方正确性状态下的效应，并沿执行图递归传播风险估计，实现了LLM多智能体系统中智能体级别的错误风险估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents and recursively propagates risk estimates through the execution graph to enable agent-level error-risk estimation in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
